findings.title: Conflicting BOM and body encoding bypass reserved proof validation
findings.description: Independent source inspection confirms that a UTF-16 BOM with a UTF-32 body decodes into NUL-interleaved reserved keys and passes through envelope()'s byte prefilter as plain evidence. The retained SECURITY r3 guarded reproduction confirms both LE and BE forms return envelope=None, evidence_exists=True, exact original bytes from read(), and audit errors=[] despite an absent gzip payload and mismatched tested/command/exit expectations. The guarded probe's actual exit is 1. This violates the evidence storage policy's requirement to reject malformed reserved encodings and allows missing raw proof to satisfy generic task/review availability. Actual M3 raw-count/JUnit/collection/selector oracles remain enforced; this finding does not claim a successful false M3 closure.
findings.required_change: Detect or reject conflicting BOM/body encodings containing reserved storage content before permitting plain fallback. Preserve opaque historical bytes. Add bounded regressions for both demonstrated LE/BE forms through retrieval, availability and budget with missing or corrupted payloads and mismatched execution metadata; retain the current exact M3 raw oracles.
